name: formula-overwrite-guard
title: Formula Overwrite Guard
description: Previews in place which cells a paste would change and how, leaves out a heading row the copy dragged along, and offers to paste values only into empty and non-formula cells; safe pastes go straight in with Undo.

meta.summary: Previews which cells a spreadsheet paste would change, so formulas, locked cells and headings aren't wiped silently.
catches: Locked cells and the heading row
Data spilling past the table edge
A heading row copied along with the data
limits: Works on the grid model you pass; it isn't connected to a spreadsheet engine
"Safe" paste skips cells rather than merging values
a11y: The preview is a role="region" with an aria-label summarising rows, columns and cell
Locked and formula cells use icons plus text
Actions are buttons with visible text
